$comment: An EXAMPLE, not a bundled blueprint: it lives outside blueprints/, so no deployment installs or promotes it. Build its archive with `pnpm --filter @gadgets/bundled-blueprints build:example` and import it by hand. Its data is a synthetic fixture in its own files.
title: Model usage (demo data)
description: Use to preview a read-only model-usage view on SYNTHETIC demo data: tokens and cost per model and provider for one demo workspace over a fixed window, each cost labelled estimated, provider-reported or billed, with freshness. It reads no real usage, bill or provider, has no bindings, and enforces no budget.
